overall: The meeting is mostly regular on votes, the roll call to enter executive session and public access. Open points are the 27.3-hour age of the revised agenda file, the union-bargaining remark about a non-union executive session, and gaps in the minutes: no document list, two votes without names, and no note of the apparent Zoom drop-off.

findings.title: Agenda file made 27 counted hours before the meeting
findings.summary: This agenda file was made 27.3 counted hours before the meeting, so this version could not have been posted 48 hours ahead. The agenda is headed REVISED, so an earlier version may have been posted sooner.

rule.quote: a public body shall post notice of every meeting at least 48 hours prior to the meeting, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays
rule.label: G.L. c.30A §20 (malegislature.gov)

rule.quote: If technical difficulties result in a remote participant being disconnected from the meeting, that fact and the time at which the disconnection occurred shall be noted in the meeting minutes.
rule.label: 940 CMR 29.00, Open Meeting Law regulations (Attorney General, clean version)

cannot_see: Deliberation outside a meeting — emails, texts or conversations among a quorum of members — leaves no trace in an agenda, minutes or a recording.

Whether executive session minutes exist, and whether they were reviewed for release as the law requires.
